<h1 align="center">Productivity OS</h1>

<p align="center">
  A modular suite of focused productivity applications built around a shared Rust backend, reusable frontend packages, plugin architecture, and common services. Productivity OS brings together tools for notes, revision, workflows, reminders, nutrition, Quran study, and mobile utilities under a single monorepo and shared platform.
</p>
